name: Yoga school in Austin, Texas
reason: No in-scope school found in three searches. Austin Yoga Institute (Iyengar, now Austin Iyengar Yoga) was the best fit, but no website of its own turned up, only directory listings and an old blog, so it was not researched (no guessed domains). Flow Yoga (flowyogatx.com) is a six-location Austin-area studio chain led by heated and general classes, and publishes its email only in script-obfuscated form. PURE Yoga Texas (pureyogatexas.com) is a hot-yoga and fitness chain in Austin and Dallas (HIIT, strength and Pilates events). Both chains fall under the brief's fitness-led chain exclusion. Owner could revisit Austin Iyengar Yoga if its own site is known.
